bundle.longDescription: Omsi-Hub turns OMSI 2 into a working bus job: real duties from the timetable, your own transport company with RosterFlow for the rosters, a career that counts, the timetable and depot editors, and friends on the same roads. It is an add-on: it builds on the openOMSI (0.2.22 or newer) and the original OMSI 2 you have installed, and never changes their files.
